name: release-checklist
description: Approval-gated release checklist. Each item is an approval step that must be explicitly confirmed before the release is marked ready.

steps.description: All automated tests pass on the release branch.
steps.prompt: Confirm: all automated tests (unit, integration, E2E) pass on the release branch for the component and version specified in the process inputs.

steps.description: CHANGELOG is updated and the release entry is complete.
steps.prompt: Confirm: CHANGELOG.md for this release is updated with all notable changes, linked issues, and a date.

steps.description: Documentation is updated to reflect any new or changed behaviour.
steps.prompt: Confirm: user-facing docs and API references are updated for this release.

steps.description: No known security issues in the release artifact.
steps.prompt: Confirm: dependency audit and any security review have been completed for this release with no open blockers.

steps.run:
set -o pipefail; jq -c '
  ([ ."confirm-tests-pass".decision, ."confirm-changelog".decision, ."confirm-docs".decision, ."confirm-security".decision ]
    | all(. == "approve")) as $ready |
  {
    release_ready: $ready,
    component: ((.inputs.component // "unknown") | tostring),
    version:   ((.inputs.version // "?") | tostring),
    message: (if $ready then "All release gates approved — ready to release."
              else "Release BLOCKED — one or more gates were rejected." end),
    gates: {
      tests:     ((."confirm-tests-pass".decision // "?") | tostring),
      changelog: ((."confirm-changelog".decision // "?") | tostring),
      docs:      ((."confirm-docs".decision // "?") | tostring),
      security:  ((."confirm-security".decision // "?") | tostring)
    }
  }
' <<< "$OSL_CONTEXT"
